news.title: Ghana's short-statured team concede 18 goals in opening two World Cup games in Morocco
news.lede: Heavy Group 4 defeats to Egypt and Paraguay left Ghana with one goal scored and 18 conceded at the Short-Statured Football World Cup in Rabat. Ghana's national short-statured football team have conceded 18 goals across their opening two matches at the 2026 Short-Statured World Cup in Rabat, Morocco, after heavy Group 4 defeats to Egypt and Paraguay. The Ghanaian side opened their group campaign on Sunday afternoon with an 8-0 loss to fellow African side Egypt at the Ibn Yassine Indoor Arena. The tough start in Rabat came on the same day the Black Challenge, Ghana's national amputee team, claimed the country's first Amputee Football World Cup trophy by beating Morocco 1-0 in Mexico.
